name: YOOAdmin
author: Rami Obeidat

sections.description:
YOOAdmin improves the default WordPress admin experience with a cleaner interface, smarter organization, and productivity-focused tools.

Designed around real-world agency, freelancer, and business workflows, YOOAdmin helps you work faster inside wp-admin without modifying WordPress core files.

Instead of replacing WordPress, YOOAdmin modernizes and reorganizes the admin experience while preserving native familiarity and compatibility.

Whether you manage one website or many, YOOAdmin creates a calmer, more organized, and more professional workspace.

Core Features

Workspace & Productivity

  • Studio Hub workspace dashboard
  • Focus Mode for distraction-free work
  • Notification Center for admin notices
  • Customizable dashboard widgets and layouts
  • Workspace notes and activity widgets
  • Light, dark, and system appearance modes

Security & Maintenance

  • Login Security with Turnstile support
  • Rate limiting and username protection
  • Hidden login URL options
  • Maintenance Mode with branded pages
  • Security dashboard widgets and shortcuts

Branding & Customization

  • Custom logos, colors, and branding
  • Modern login page customization
  • Live login page preview
  • Theme and appearance settings
  • Frontend toolbar appearance controls

Admin Experience

  • Enhanced Posts, Pages, Categories, and Tags views
  • Improved Users management screens
  • Better admin menu organization
  • Translation ready and RTL friendly
  • Multisite compatible
  • Optional full data cleanup
  • No frontend impact
  • Fully reversible using WordPress hooks

Studio Hub

Studio Hub introduces a calmer, workspace-focused WordPress experience inspired by modern productivity applications.

It provides a cleaner dashboard home, customizable workspace sections, activity widgets, workspace notes, and a more focused workflow inside wp-admin.

Notification Center

YOOAdmin converts distracting plugin notices and admin banners into a cleaner and more organized notification center experience.

Important messages stay accessible while your workspace remains focused and uncluttered.

Focus Mode

Reduce clutter and stay productive.

Focus Mode simplifies the admin area by minimizing distractions and improving clarity while you work.

Login Page Customizer

Create a modern branded WordPress login page with live preview, custom logos, side images, and clean layout options.

Improve the login experience for yourself, your team, or your clients.

Branding & Customization

Make WordPress feel like your own workspace:

  • Upload custom logo
  • Change colors
  • Customize workspace appearance
  • Improve client-facing admin experience

Optional Account Connection

YOOAdmin works fully without creating or connecting any external account.

You may optionally connect your website to a YOOAdmin account for account linking and status verification only.

Connecting an account does not disable or unlock core plugin features.

Privacy

If account connection is used, the plugin may communicate with yooadmin.io for verification purposes.

This may include:

  • Website URL
  • Server IP address

No personal data, visitor data, analytics, or user tracking data is collected.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect personal data by default.

If account connection is used, website URL and server IP may be used only for verification.

YOOAdmin Plus (optional separate plugin)

YOOAdmin Plus is an optional companion plugin. It is not included in the free YOOAdmin package on WordPress.org and is not installed automatically when you activate YOOAdmin.

To use Plus:

  1. Connect your YOOAdmin account from the dashboard (optional; only if you use Plus or account-linked features).
  2. Download the YOOAdmin Plus plugin package from your account at yooadmin.io (portal login when your license is active).
  3. Install Plus manually via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or upload the files to /wp-content/plugins/yooadmin-plus/.
  4. Activate YOOAdmin Plus from Plugins or from the Studio Hub Updates widget (user-initiated only; uses the same WordPress plugin activation APIs as the Plugins screen).

YOOAdmin Lite works fully without YOOAdmin Plus. Plus adds premium extensions and features documented on yooadmin.io. No third-party plugin is activated without an explicit action by an administrator with the activate_plugins capability.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/yooadmin, or install through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. After activation, the setup wizard opens automatically.
  4. Complete the quick setup steps.
  5. Start using your new workspace.
sections.faq:
Is YOOAdmin free?

Yes. All core features included in this version are free.

Do I need to connect an account?

No. The plugin works fully without any connection.

Does it modify WordPress core files?

No. YOOAdmin uses standard WordPress hooks and can be removed cleanly.

Does it slow down my website?

No. It runs only inside the admin workspace and does not affect the frontend.

Can I use it on client websites?

Yes.

Does it support multisite?

Yes.

Is YOOAdmin translation ready?

Yes. YOOAdmin follows WordPress localization standards and supports community translations through WordPress.org.

Is my data tracked?

No user tracking or analytics data is collected.

Does YOOAdmin leave data behind after removal?

No. YOOAdmin includes an optional cleanup tool that can safely remove plugin settings, notifications, and custom tables.
